title: Generate discretized defect arcs
action: For each lattice size L in {20,40,50,75,100,150} and a range of curvature values K=1/R (with integer R), generate a set of lattice nodes that approximate a circular arc of contour length L. Use the discretization algorithm described. Also generate a reference arc with very small curvature. Save the defect node coordinates.

title: Monte Carlo simulation for curved defect lines
action: Run Monte Carlo simulation of the 2D Ising model (J=1, 1/T=0.44) for each defect configuration from step01 and the reference configuration, obtaining total energies E_tot(K) and E_tot(K0). Save the energies as intermediate files.

title: Compute specific energy for curved lines
action: For each L and K, compute e_per_L = (E_tot(K) - E_tot(K0))/L and write all records to curved_line_energies.csv.
description: CSV file containing the specific bending energy per unit length for curved defect lines.

title: Construct defect-antidefect pair configurations
action: On a 20x20 lattice, create configurations with a defect-antidefect pair: one vacancy and one adjacent atom (antidefect) separated by distance d = 1,...,10. Also construct a reference configuration with defects at the maximum distance (d=10 or half L).

title: Monte Carlo simulation for defect-antidefect pairs
action: Run Monte Carlo simulation at 1/T=0.44 for each pair configuration and the reference, obtaining total energies E_DA(d) and E_ref.

title: Compute defect-antidefect interaction energies
action: For each distance d, compute the interaction energy E_int(d) = E_DA(d) - E_ref. Write the results to pair_interaction_energies.csv.
description: CSV file with defect-antidefect interaction energies vs. separation.
